items.name: Readability
items.evidence: This is a two-line change that matches the reference exactly. The comment '# Ensure base table is in aliases.' explains why the call is there, and the formatting matches the surrounding code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() inside single_alias. No duplicated logic, dead code or debug leftovers, and Collector/QuerySet.delete are untouched.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: This minimal fix calls an existing idempotent helper. It adds no swallowed errors, no magic constants and no new failure paths. The delete, delete_regress and queries suites pass (456 tests), as do the hidden tests (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias by registering the base alias before counting, so the MySQL override keeps working. Deletes with joins still use the subquery, there is no backend-specific branch, and the change is identical to the reference.
